title: surveyoffice
description: Admin tool for refreshing Minecraft map wall tiles on Paper and Purpur servers.
body:
SurveyOffice is a Paper/Purpur plugin that allows administrators to refresh map wall tiles without manually removing maps from item frames.

Use /survey update, then right-click any map in an item frame. The plugin temporarily teleports the admin through the map area to force all map chunks to render, updates the map (including locked maps), and returns the admin to their original location.

Perfect for large map walls, town displays, and world map installations.
